```{r}
# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(dplyr)
```
```{r}
data_url <- "https://www2.stat.duke.edu/~pdh10/FCBS/Exercises/interexp.dat"
df <- read.table(data_url, header = FALSE, col.names = c("A", "B"))
df[df == "."] <- NA
df[] <- lapply(df, as.numeric)
```
```{r}
df <- df[!(is.na(df$A) & is.na(df$B)), ]
```
```{r}
complete <- na.omit(df)
missing_A <- df[is.na(df$A) & !is.na(df$B), ]
missing_B <- df[!is.na(df$A) & is.na(df$B), ]
```
```{r}
mu <- colMeans(complete)
Sigma <- cov(complete)

```

```{r}
loglik_bivariate <- function(df_original, mu, Sigma) {
  ll <- 0
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_original)) {
    obs <- !is.na(df_original[i, ])
    if (sum(obs) == 0) next
    x_obs <- unlist(df_original[i, obs])
    mu_obs <- mu[obs]
    Sigma_obs <- Sigma[obs, obs, drop = FALSE]
    if (det(Sigma_obs) <= 0 || any(is.na(Sigma_obs))) next
    diff <- matrix(x_obs - mu_obs, ncol = 1)
    ll <- ll - 0.5 * (log(det(Sigma_obs)) + t(diff) %*% solve(Sigma_obs) %*% diff + length(x_obs) * log(2 * pi))
  }
  return(ll)
}
```

```{r}
df_imputed <- df
prev_ll <- -Inf
tolerance <- 1e-4

for (iteration in 1:100) {
  # E-step: Fill missing values
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_imputed)) {
    a <- df_imputed$A[i]
    b <- df_imputed$B[i]
    
    if (is.na(a) && !is.na(b)) {
      df_imputed$A[i] <- mu[1] + (Sigma[1, 2] / Sigma[2, 2]) * (b - mu[2])
    } else if (!is.na(a) && is.na(b)) {
      df_imputed$B[i] <- mu[2] + (Sigma[2, 1] / Sigma[1, 1]) * (a - mu[1])
    }
  }
  
  # M-step: Update parameters
  mu_new <- colMeans(df_imputed)
  Sigma_new <- cov(df_imputed)
  new_ll <- loglik_bivariate(df, mu_new, Sigma_new)
  
  cat(sprintf("Iter %d | Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", iteration, new_ll))
  if (abs(new_ll - prev_ll) < tolerance || is.na(new_ll)) break
  
  mu <- mu_new
  Sigma <- Sigma_new
  prev_ll <- new_ll
}
```

```{r}
df_imputed$Status <- ifelse(is.na(df$A) | is.na(df$B), "Imputed", "Observed")
df_imputed <- df_imputed[complete.cases(df_imputed), ]
```

```{r}
before <- summarise(complete,
                    Mean_A = mean(A), Var_A = var(A),
                    Mean_B = mean(B), Var_B = var(B)
)
after <- summarise(df_imputed,
                   Mean_A = mean(A), Var_A = var(A),
                   Mean_B = mean(B), Var_B = var(B)
)

# Restructure summary stats
results <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("A", "B"),
  Before_Mean = c(before$Mean_A, before$Mean_B),
  Before_Var = c(before$Var_A, before$Var_B),
  After_Mean = c(after$Mean_A, after$Mean_B),
  After_Var = c(after$Var_A, after$Var_B)
)

cat("\n📊 Summary Statistics Before and After Imputation:\n")
print(results)
```

```{r}
# Define custom color palette
custom_colors <- c("Observed" = "#1f77b4", "Imputed" = "#ff7f0e")

# Histogram - Stimulus A
g1 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = A, fill = Status)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, bins = 10, position = 'identity', color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(title = "Histogram - Stimulus A", x = "Stimulus A", y = "Count")

# Histogram - Stimulus B
g2 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = B, fill = Status)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, bins = 10, position = 'identity', color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Histogram - Stimulus B", x = "Stimulus B", y = "Count")

# Boxplot - Stimulus A
g3 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = Status, y = A, fill = Status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.color = "gray30", outlier.shape = 16) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot - Stimulus A", x = "", y = "Stimulus A")

# Boxplot - Stimulus B
g4 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = Status, y = B, fill = Status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.color = "gray30", outlier.shape = 16) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot - Stimulus B", x = "", y = "Stimulus B")

# Scatter plot - Before imputation (complete cases only)
g5 <- ggplot(complete, aes(x = A, y = B)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2ca02c", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot (Before Imputation)", x = "Stimulus A", y = "Stimulus B")

# Scatter plot - After imputation (with source)
g6 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = A, y = B, color = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot (After Imputation)", x = "Stimulus A", y = "Stimulus B")

# Define your custom colors (same as before)
custom_colors <- c("Observed" = "#1f77b4", "Imputed" = "#ff7f0e")

# Density Plot - Stimulus A
g7 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = A, fill = Status, color = Status)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Density Plot - Stimulus A", x = "Stimulus A", y = "Density")

# Density Plot - Stimulus B
g8 <- ggplot(df_imputed, aes(x = B, fill = Status, color = Status)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Density Plot - Stimulus B", x = "Stimulus B", y = "Density")

grid.arrange(g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8, ncol = 2)

```
